question: Should `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` become a supported QQBot data-root contract, or should the diagnostic stop recommending an unsupported override?
rationale: The source mismatch is clear, but adding an env-controlled storage root affects compatibility and security boundaries while adjacent tests preserve existing home-root behavior.

options.title: Support `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` with upgrade proof
options.body: Make the env var an explicit QQBot plugin contract, add tests for default and override roots, and preserve existing state safely.

options.title: Retire the env hint
options.body: Remove or revise the diagnostic recommendation so users are not told to set an unsupported variable.

options.title: Defer to broader storage migration
options.body: Keep this open until QQBot data-root ownership is fully settled around plugin SQLite state and legacy imports.

recommendation.title: Support `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Make the env var an explicit QQBot plugin contract, add tests for default and override roots, and preserve existing state safely.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QQBot storage migration work makes this the best available owner for the data-root contract decision.
